spineDefinition.note: The Git spine is the platform registry + derived-intel structural index in Supabase. It is NOT the federated repo index.
spineDefinition.quotedRule: repository_index_status resolves only against Supabase registry after import. Local index/latest/* is repository-local and is not Git-spine admission proof.
spineDefinition.corollary: Visual-Asset-Engine/index/cg-federated-repo-index.v1.json is likewise NOT Git-spine admission proof.
